temperature_thresholds.explanation: Demand is minimized in the 18-22°C comfort band, rises steeply above 24-25°C across all states due to fans/AC/pumping (+2.5% to +3.6% per °C in northern grids), and rises below 15°C in northern states (Delhi, Uttar Pradesh) due to winter water/space heating.

grid_recommendations.title: Two-Tier Heatwave Reserve & Day-Ahead Procurement Protocol
grid_recommendations.finding: Demand surges sharply above 24-25°C (+3.5%/°C in Delhi, +2.9%/°C in UP) and 7-day rolling mean temperature is a top-3 weather predictor due to multi-day thermal buildup.
grid_recommendations.action: Northern SLDCs and DISCOMs should trigger Tier-1 cooling dispatch at T_mean > 25°C and Tier-2 bilateral/peaker reserve procurement 48h ahead when 7-day rolling mean temperature exceeds 30°C.

grid_recommendations.title: Inter-Regional Monsoon Power Banking & Maintenance Scheduling
grid_recommendations.finding: Maharashtra and Kerala peak in April and drop 12-14% during July-August southwest monsoon rains, whereas Delhi and UP peak in June-August.
grid_recommendations.action: Expand Western-to-Northern grid power banking during June-September and schedule coal/nuclear maintenance in July-August for Western/Southern grids and November-February for Northern grids.

grid_recommendations.title: Automated Sunday & State-Holiday Baseload Ramp-Down and Storage Charging
grid_recommendations.finding: Sundays reduce demand by 7.5% (-6.8 MU) in Delhi, 8.0% (-5.7 MU) in Kerala, and 3.7% (-16.8 MU) in Maharashtra; official state holidays reduce demand by up to 8.8%.
grid_recommendations.action: Pre-schedule thermal unit turndown to technical minimum and route midday solar into pumped-hydro/battery storage on Sundays and state holidays instead of curtailing renewables.

grid_recommendations.title: Dual-Horizon Model Deployment (Set A for Seasonal Planning, Set B for Day-Ahead Dispatch)
grid_recommendations.finding: LightGBM Set A (weather + calendar only) explains 94.1% of variance in Delhi and 88.3% in Kerala; Set B (adding 1d and 7d demand lags) achieves 1.54%-2.81% day-ahead MAPE.
grid_recommendations.action: Use Set A with 15-90 day weather ensembles for fuel/contract planning, and Set B in SLDC control rooms for day-ahead (t+1) dispatch.
